eyebrow: Watsi · NYC Bryant Park · 22 Sep 2026 · Are You Happy
title: Paul:
headline: A father asks himself “Am I happy?” His answer is his two boys, and that love is stronger than hate.
story: Nick asks a man sitting on the stone steps in Bryant Park: are you happy? Paul repeats the question to himself. Then he answers: people who care about him, and two magnificent boys who mean the world to him. He was just handed a $10 Watsi card to help a stranger he will never meet. He says yes, absolutely.
He ends with his message for the world, holding the blue card: love is much stronger than hate. One person, one honest answer. Warm and hopeful from start to end.
do: Open on frame 1 with Paul talking and the question as top text. No fade, no logo.
Keep captions on the whole time. One text at a time.
Make the name super large. First name only: “Paul”.
End on the blue card in his hand while he says “love conquers all”.
dont: No title card or logo at 0:00.
No “is there a catch” part (01:48–02:12). It belongs to the compilation video.
Don't name his sons. He does not name them.
No sad music, no slow motion.
